headline: JonDeTech Shares Surge 25% on Health Ring Sensor Supply Agreement
summary: Shares in Swedish sensor developer JonDeTech jumped up to 25% on Tuesday following the announcement of a commercial partnership agreement with an international smart health ring manufacturer.
why: Commercial adoption by consumer wearable makers provides small-cap sensor technology developers with volume manufacturing scale and revenue validation.
